title: Dixie E NDE 3125
content: According to the registered nurse, an old lady visiting someone in the hospital (Darien) saw me sitting in my car, looking 'dead.' I was taken by a stretcher into the emergency room. What I experienced was partly real. I saw two large men in all white (probably the attendants who carried me into the emergency room) standing by me as I sat in a white room. A doctor (I thought) started asking me many questions. At first I thought, 'Well, it's a hospital, so they have to fill out forms.' But he started to ask about back into my early childhood. I suddenly saw a large reel of film behind this 'doctor's' head. A hand came from the left and pulled the film out and I could see the negative images of my life. I yelled 'NO' and came 'to' in the emergency room. I was standing in the doorway of the room where they were actually working on me. I felt in the way. I asked a registered nurse, 'Should I go into the waiting room? That woman looks really sick.' I did not feel connected to my body at all. Nor did I know who she was. I started walking down the hall of the hospital and got very scared when I realized my shoulder was partway through the wall! Nobody was paying any attention to me. Suddenly, I was attached to my feet looking down into a rocky stream of water. Above was a canopy of trees. I felt like the trees were encouraging me to 'go.' I said NO and it was like diving off a diving board backwards into my body. I just fell into my body and said, 'Work.' The registered nurse said, 'No you don't, we just started you back up.' I told friends about this and they sent me books by Dr. Raymond Moody, etc. I hadn't heard of NDE at this time, to my memory, and I read a lot.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Standing in the doorway of the room where they were working on her; walking down the hospital hall; noticing her shoulder partway through a wall.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two large men in all white; a 'doctor' asking questions; later, a canopy of trees that felt encouraging.

environment.environment_other_detail: Rocky stream of water below; canopy of trees above.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Described as 'diving off a diving board backwards into my body' and 'just fell into my body.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Hospital scene with attendants/doctor and film-reel imagery; later outdoors above a rocky stream with trees encouraging her to 'go.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience included a hospital-room questioning with film-reel life images, then an OBE in the hospital hallway, then a nature scene above a stream before returning to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Saw a large film reel behind the 'doctor's' head; a hand pulled film out showing negative images of her life; later felt attached to her feet looking down into a rocky stream with trees encouraging her to 'go.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I suddenly saw a large reel of film behind this 'doctor's' head.” “I could see the negative images of my life.” “I did not feel connected to my body at all.” “I realized my shoulder was partway through the wall!” “I felt like the trees were encouraging me to 'go.'” “it was like diving off a diving board backwards into my body.”
